newsitem.title: USA: Marathon raises U.S. posted crude prices. [CORRECTED 00:12 GMT 26/2]
newsitem.headline: Marathon raises U.S. posted crude prices. [CORRECTED 00:12 GMT 26/2]

text.p: Marathon Oil, a unit of USX Corp, said it had raised the price it will pay for U.S. crude oil by 25 cents, effective Tuesday.
The increase brings the new price for U.S. benchmark grade West Texas Intermediate to $19.25 a barrel and West Texas Sour to $17.65 a barrel (company corrects price from $17.75 a barrel).
Light Louisiana sweet crude is now $19.50 and Oklahoma sweet is $19.25.
